title: DESCO Smart
description: Enterprise-grade prepaid electricity monitoring platform with multi-meter dashboards, real-time burn-rate analytics, runway forecasting and automated SMTP alerts. Built with Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase (PostgreSQL with RLS) and a Python 3.12 background monitor worker.
